---
title: "Hexagonal binning"
description: "Twenty thousand points binned into hexagons, shaded by count with a perceptual palette."
categories: [Heatmaps]
---



When a scatter would be an unreadable blob, bin it. `mark_hex()` aggregates
points into hexagonal cells; `scale_fill_continuous()` takes a named perceptual
palette (here Batlow).


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
set.seed(1)
n <- 20000
df <- data.frame(x = rnorm(n), y = rnorm(n) + rnorm(n, 0, 0.4))

p <- vplot(df) |>
  mark_hex(x = x, y = y, bins = 30) |>
  scale_fill_continuous(palette = "Batlow") |>
  labs(title = "Twenty thousand points, hexagonal bins")
```
